originVault.title: 01 · Farah's Original Handmade Prototype Hat
originVault.subtitle: Where the silhouette was born
originVault.caption: A single hand-crocheted dusty-rose ribbed beanie whose square top corners naturally formed pointed cat ears when worn—sparking the entire FINNESSE crochet movement.

originVault.title: 02 · Original Cherry Drop Styling Reference
originVault.subtitle: Varsity lettering & 3D fruit motif
originVault.caption: The foundational look pairing the red-and-pink FINNESSE cat-ear beanie with a matching cherry-appliqué cropped tank.

originVault.title: 03 · Original Y2K Pink Collection Poster
originVault.subtitle: Handmade Crochet · Limited Drops
originVault.caption: Early concept board uniting Cherry Drop, 904 Skyline, Leopard, and The Way faith-series hats around a single statement silhouette.

originVault.title: 04 · FINNESSE WORLD Velvet Showroom Poster
originVault.subtitle: Cherry Drop · The Way Series · 904 Edition · Essentials
originVault.caption: The four-pillar brand architecture laid out on wooden atelier shelves against a red velvet stage.

originVault.title: 05 · 'THE WAY' Faith × Streetwear Editorial Poster
originVault.subtitle: Faith / Fashion / Culture
originVault.caption: Exploring spiritual iconography—crosses, crowns, doves, and bold typography—through heavy-gauge handmade crochet.
